title: There were 546 multiracial students enrolled in Windham County schools in 2023-24 school year | Ne Connecticut News
text:
Charlene M. Russell-Tucker, Commissioner for the Connecticut State Department of Education | https://portal.ct.gov/
Charlene M. Russell-Tucker, Commissioner for the Connecticut State Department of Education | https://portal.ct.gov/
according to the Connecticut State Department of Education.
Data showed that Windham County welcomed 15,152 students during the 2023-24 school year. Among them, multiracial students comprised 3.6% of the student body to be the third most represented ethnicity in the county.
Among the 40 schools in Windham County, Killingly Intermediate School recorded the highest enrollment of multiracial students in the 2023-24 school year, with a total of 56 students.
Student enrollment has been dropping in Connecticut’s public schools for over a decade now. With the exception of a slight relief in the 2021-22 school year, schools in the state have lost more than 30,000 students since 2014.
